description: This file contains a function 'initAboutMeScreen' that performs initialization and accessibility enhancements for the 'About Me' screen within a web application. It adjusts layout sizing, adds focus styles for keyboard accessibility, and optimizes image loading hints. The function is exposed globally for invocation after script load, typically by a React app.
external_files: Styles and images within the DOM

methods.name: initAboutMeScreen()
methods.description: Initializes layout adjustments, accessibility features, and image loading hints specifically for the 'About Me' screen. Sets fixed dimensions, adds focus outlines for keyboard navigation, and asynchronously loads images for performance.
